Union Suite · WIP prototype · display only

Activity and record cards

One card design for every list that reads as a history: the combined Recent activity feed, Notes, Cases, Meetings and Communications. Each list shows the Candidate: the owner's original card translated to theme tokens: its structure kept (a quiet type line, one bold headline, one muted preview line, and date, time and actions in a right-hand column); colour only on the rail icon and for importance; the note itself as the headline when there is no subject; a slim section switcher for the feed's types. The options below change it further.

Recent activity also shows the Supplied card, the owner's original design, frozen: its own markup, colours, type sizes and icons, in a separate frame that no theme or candidate styling can reach. The candidate uses the Query Templates in prototypes/wip/activity-cards/templates/, inside the wrappers iMIS generates, with the shipped theme CSS. The card adapts to the width of the list, not the window. Click a card to expand it. Recent activity is the real US-ACTIVITY-FEED module from the contact page v3 prototype, answered from sample records; links go nowhere.
